nota.t: Observing · Classifying · Measuring · Making inferences · Predicting · Communicating

baris: use the senses to gather information
separate things according to the same characteristics
make measurements with the correct tools and units

make an expectation about something that will happen
convey information in the form of tables, graphs or verbally
describe the change of something over time
determine what is changed, observed and fixed

nota.t: Humans grow — gain height and weight. Everyone's growth is different.
Children inherit characteristics from their parents, such as hair colour, face shape, skin colour.
A balanced diet contains carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, mineral salts, fiber and water.

glosari: Traits that are passed down from parent to child.
Foods that contain all food classes in the right quantities.

nota.t: Animals need food, water, air and shelter.

glosari: Animals that eat plants and animals.

nota.t: Plants need water, sunlight and air to live and grow.

glosari: Stems that are cut and planted to grow into new trees.
Small plants that have just sprouted.

nota.t: Things that give off their own light: the sun, lamps, candles, fire, stars, fireflies.
Shadows are formed when light is blocked by an opaque object.

baris: light passes through it completely (clear glass)

glosari: Does not allow light to pass through.
Dark areas formed when light is blocked.

nota.t: dry cell (battery), mains electricity supply, generator, solar cell
The bulb will light if the circuit is complete: dry cell, wire, bulb and switch are connected without disconnection.
Do not touch the switch with wet hands · Do not insert objects into the socket · Do not fly kites near electric cables

glosari: Components to turn the circuit on or off.

nota.t: Soluble in water: sugar, salt, coffee powder, beverage powder.
refining (sand and water) · sieving (rice and flour) · using magnets (nails and sand) · picking by hand (peas and marbles)

glosari: Disappears and mixes completely in water.
A combination of two or more ingredients.
How to separate insoluble substances from liquids.

nota.t: Rainwater, rivers, lakes, seas and groundwater.
Seawater evaporates → forms clouds → falls as rain → flows into rivers and seas.
Do not throw garbage into the river; save water.

glosari: The process of water turning into steam.
The process of water vapor becoming water droplets.

nota.t: Technology is a tool or means that makes human work easier.
paddle → grinding machine · rowing boat → boat engine · broom → vacuum cleaner
Technology makes work easier but can be dangerous if not used properly.

glosari: The use of knowledge to produce tools that make work easier.
